description: Full-text search of the electronic Indiana Administrative Code. year is an edition year such as 2006; omit it to use the edition iar.iga.in.gov labels Current. Returns section ids, headings and snippets; fetch text with iac_get_section. title is an IAC title number such as '10' or '312'. Unofficial; not legal advice. Verify at iar.iga.in.gov.
name: iac_search
title: Search the Indiana Administrative Code
